apps.name: Live TV
apps.tagline: Free live TV channels by country, on your phone or TV
apps.description: Watch live channels that broadcasters stream publicly, sorted by country. Opens on Pakistani, Indian (Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi) and Canadian channels, with a channel grid, logos, search, favourites and a full-screen player. Works with TV remotes, supports picture-in-picture, and can also play your own M3U playlist. The app updates itself when a new version is out.
apps.whatsNew: Version 1.9.10: Browse mode, a home screen with big channel cards, plus News, CP24 and Home screens, games and the Library of movies and dramas.

apps.name: Live TV Max
apps.tagline: Live channels, a TV guide, movies and dramas on one home screen
apps.description: A streaming-style home screen for free live TV: big channel cards in rows by country and by language, with a live preview of the highlighted channel. Many channels show what's on now and next. Urdu and Hindi dramas, movies, shows and kids' programmes from the channels' own official uploads sit in the same rows, with a row to continue what you started. Installs next to Live TV, needs no sign-in, works with TV remotes and updates itself.

apps.name: Live Cam
apps.tagline: Watch your CCTV and IP cameras live, on phone or Google TV
apps.description: This app is specially designed for Android TVs and Wyze cameras: sign in with your Wyze username and password, and all your Wyze cameras appear live in one grid. Tap or press OK for full screen with sound. You can also add other cameras by brand and IP address (Hikvision, Dahua, Amcrest, Lorex, Reolink, Tapo, Uniview, ONVIF and more) or paste any RTSP or HTTP address. Your logins stay on your device, and the app updates itself.

apps.name: Multi Chat
apps.tagline: All your WhatsApp accounts in one app, on your PC and phone
apps.description: Use several WhatsApp accounts at the same time, each in its own separate box: business, personal and more. Each account is the official WhatsApp Web, signed in with its own QR code (or “Log in with phone number” on the same phone), so nothing is modified and your accounts stay safe. Give every account a name, colour and photo, see its unread count, and get notifications that say which account a message is for. Mute an account or set quiet hours, save quick replies and type them into a chat with one tap, and lock the app with a PIN (or fingerprint on the phone). On a Windows PC you can show all accounts side by side, and it runs in the tray. Multi Chat never sends messages by itself, and it is not made by or connected with WhatsApp or Meta.
apps.whatsNew: First version, for Windows PCs and Android phones.

apps.name: Notes for Claude
apps.tagline: Voice notes, a work list and ideas, sent to Claude in one tap
apps.description: Keep everything you want Claude to work on in one place on your phone. Type work to do or ideas, or tap the microphone and speak: your phone's speech to text turns voice notes into text (English, Urdu, Hindi or Punjabi). Every note has a topic, like Live TV or Website. When you're ready, tap Send to Claude: your ticked notes become one tidy message grouped by topic, copied and opened in Claude. Give a topic its own Claude project link and its notes go straight to that project chat. Sent notes are kept in a Sent list, and the app updates itself.
